traits: beat the block game on hardcore with half a heart (day 4)
ate a billion burgers, which launched him into space on a cartoon poop jet; belly deflated back to a stick (day 5)

rocked a mom's baby to sleep and fell asleep holding it; she kissed him on the cheek and he blushed (day 6). The mom (O.draw_mom: long brown hair + bun, pink dress) shops at the burger place - callback possible

EXPELLED FOREVER from wizard school (day 7): read his acceptance letter, sprinted into the 9 3/4 wall and bounced off, used the door in the wall instead, the giant talking hat found no brain in his head (hello... echoed) and blasted him into the empty white room

flew a plane (day 8): took off from the FLIGHT SCHOOL airfield, looped until he went green, climbed out of the atmosphere into space, puked a zero-g blob (back to normal), fell back down on fire and planted the plane nose-first in the field; the flaming puke landed next to him. He looks completely normal again (no soot, no tint).

went to green hill (day 9): collected rings deadpan, ran until his legs were a blur wheel, ran a giant loop, RINGS 999, blasted past the GOAL sign and skidded to a stop; victory stance with a peace sign; the most harmless little ladybug robot puttered up, poked him and knocked him flat on his back; every ring burst out of him (RINGS 0). Looks normal.

took the ring to mordor (day 10, re-cut 2): snatched the last ring on green hill, ran to the black gate (ONE DOES NOT SIMPLY WALK INTO MORDOR), whistled up a giant eagle; when the eye's searchlight closed in he put the ring on and went invisible, so the beam locked on the eagle carrying a floating ring, and the eagle dropped him into the volcano; he dropped the ring into the lava and nearly went in after it (speed-game reflex), it melted; the eye blew up, the tower fell, the volcano fired him out into the rubble; the eagle showed up after it was all over. He lives in Mordor now. Looks normal.

built a CAT RESCUE SHELTER and was happy about it (day 11, re-cut): ran out of Mordor into a sunny town, found a black kitten in a FREE KITTEN box (slow blinks), built the shelter, rescued a cat from a tree and a line of kittens, fed them (one can - every head turned), they chose the box over the fancy bed, a cat pushed his mug off the shelf (he caught it), on adoption day the mom from day 6 adopted the orange cat, he stamped ADOPTED on every photo - the last was the kitten's, so he adopted it. Real smile. It rides on his head now. Looks normal.

took his cat to the theme park (day 12): ran from the town into FUN PARK; teacups - the kitten batted the wheel until it spun crazy fast and he laughed for real, then dizzy; YOU MUST BE THIS TALL - short by a hair until the kitten sat up on his head (DING); THE BIG ONE coaster: lift hill, hang at the top, the kitten's slow blink gave him the nerve, arms up (despite KEEP ARMS AND LEGS INSIDE), drop, two loops, airtime, FLASH; the RIDE PHOTO shows him screaming with joy and the kitten bored. Looks normal.

went to the movies (day 14): ran out of FUN PARK's back gate (BYE NOW!) to MEGAPLEX 30 (EXPLOSION 7, NOW IN 4D); NO PETS - the kitten flattened into a hat and the usher let it slide; SMALL popcorn $47.50, bigger than him; the card reader asked for a tip and he pressed 30% ($61.75) under the cashier's stare; an empty theater and a giant in a top hat sat right in front of him (leaning didn't help); 47 previews, ate all the popcorn before the movie; the 4D seat sprayed him, blew him dry, bucked like a rodeo, launched the tall guy through the roof and looped him around the theater; he finally saw the KA-BOOM; stayed for the post-credits scene and the tall guy fell back in through the roof. Looks normal.
world.notes: Day 14: deadpan / Family Guy timing; the kitten is never harmed. Every episode moves on to a new world.
